st: Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a large pot and brown the lamb. Add the onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste, harissa, turmeric and [[1 tsp]] salt for 1 minute.
Add [[6 cups]] water and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer.
Add the carrots and chickpeas and simmer.
Add the zucchini and cook until tender.
Put the couscous in a bowl with [[1 tsp]] salt and [[1 tbsp]] oil, rub together, then pour over [[1 cup]] hot water. Cover and rest.
Fluff with a fork, dot with butter, and steam briefly or microwave until hot.
Mound the couscous on a platter and ladle the meat and vegetables over.
Mix the tuna, parsley, capers, onion, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Lay one pastry sheet flat and spoon a quarter of the tuna filling slightly off-center in a ring shape.
Make a small well in the middle and carefully crack an egg into it.
Fold the sheet over to form a half-moon and press the edges to seal; dab with a little water if needed.
Heat [[2 cups]] oil in a deep skillet to 350°F (175°C).
Slide the brik in gently and fry, spooning oil over the top.
Turn once when golden, about 1 minute per side.
Drain on paper towels. The egg should be soft inside; cook longer if you prefer it firm. Serve hot with lemon.
Heat the oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Cook the onion and peppers until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and harissa and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and salt and simmer until thick.
Make six small wells in the sauce with a spoon.
Crack an egg into each well.
Cover and cook on low until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft, about 6 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve from the pan with bread.
Put the chickpeas, [[4 cups]] water and half of the garlic in a pot. Bring to a boil.
Add [[1 tsp]] cumin and the salt and simmer to flavor the broth.
Mash some of the chickpeas to thicken it slightly.
Boil the eggs in a small pot for 7 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Place torn bread in each bowl.
Ladle the hot chickpeas and broth over the bread.
Top with the remaining garlic, cumin, lemon juice, harissa and [[4 tbsp]] oil.
Add a halved boiled egg and capers and serve right away.
Break the chilies open and shake out the seeds for milder harissa.
Soak the chilies in hot water until soft, then drain well.
Toast the caraway and coriander in a dry pan until fragrant, then grind them.
Put the chilies, garlic, ground spices, salt and half of the oil in a food processor.
Blend into a thick paste, adding more oil as needed.
Taste and add lemon juice if you like.
Spoon into a clean jar and pour a layer of oil on top. Store in the fridge.
Heat a grill or the oven broiler. Roast the peppers, tomatoes, chili and garlic, turning, until charred all over.
Place the peppers and chili in a bowl, cover, and let steam.
Peel the peppers, chili, tomatoes and garlic and remove the seeds from the peppers.
Chop everything finely.
Mix with the olive oil, lemon juice, caraway and salt.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes if not already done, cool and peel.
Spoon the salad on a plate and top with tuna and egg.
Heat the oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Brown the sausage slices until cooked through.
Add the garlic, bell pepper and caraway and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the harissa for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, salt and [[0.5 cup]] water and simmer until saucy.
Make wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook until the whites are set and the yolks are as firm as you like, 5 to 6 minutes.
Serve straight from the pan with bread.
Mix the semolina, salt and [[0.5 cup]] olive oil with your fingers until sandy. Rest for 30 minutes.
Add [[0.5 cup]] warm water bit by bit and knead to a soft dough.
Mash the dates with the cinnamon and orange blossom water into a paste.
Shape the dough into logs, press a groove in the middle, fill with date paste and close it.
Flatten slightly and cut into diamonds.
Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C) and fry until golden brown.
Warm the honey with [[0.25 cup]] water for the syrup.
Dip the hot pastries in the syrup, drain, and cool.
Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add water and olive oil to make a soft dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise until doubled.
Shape into small oval rolls and let rest.
Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C) and fry the rolls until golden, then drain.
Boil the potatoes until tender, and boil the eggs for 10 minutes. Cool, then dice and slice.
Slit each roll open and spread with harissa.
Stuff with tuna, potato, egg and olives. Eat warm.
Heat the oil in a wide pan to medium-high.
Fry the potatoes until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
Fry the pumpkin, zucchini and peppers in batches until soft and browned.
Drain the oil from the pan except [[1 tbsp]].
Cook the garlic and tomatoes for 5 minutes.
Return the vegetables, then chop everything coarsely with the edge of a spatula.
Crack in the eggs, season with salt, cumin and harissa, and stir until set.
Serve hot with bread.
